purpose: REPLICATION ONLY. This is not a mechanism search.
primary_question: Does the silence finding observed in batch 6 reproduce under an independently selected new English nonfiction corpus with the unchanged production pipeline v1.2.1?

frozen_pipeline.validator: stepfun/step-3.7-flash via Kilo gateway, shipped VALIDATOR_PROMPT (unchanged)

no_transfer_rule: No batch-6 hypothesis is transferred. Recipient rejections, assertion scope, serve-lexicon, implicit arguments, theme role, density and all other batch-6 findings stay out of the analysis. They are not predictors, not stratification variables and not exclusion criteria.

source_rules.kind: new heterogeneous English nonfiction, NOT another Wikipedia round
source_rules.rationale: batch 6 sampled Wikipedia; a second round would mostly re-test sampling conditions, whereas a heterogeneous corpus tests material independence
source_rules.pre_registered: source set defined BEFORE selection; no selection by expected difficulty
source_rules.no_post_hoc_removal: problematic texts are never removed afterwards
source_rules.sampling: different mechanism than the batch-6 mechanical stride; pre-defined, not selected by outcome

procedure: 1. define and digest-pin the new corpus
2. run the unchanged production pipeline over the whole corpus
3. freeze all records before any annotation
4. draw a pre-defined sample of ~80 records (NOT selected by silence status)
5. blind-annotate that sample (sentence + gold roles only)
6. unblind and answer the primary question

operational_definition_of_silence.rule: reuse the existing frozen operational definition unchanged; no refinement at the transition
operational_definition_of_silence.note: candidate generation produced no pair for a sentence that gold marks as containing a provides relation

sampling_rule.unit: pipeline record (all records from the frozen run, pooled without outcome filtering)
sampling_rule.method: deterministic: seeded shuffle of the frozen record list, first 80
forbidden: dropping items after seeing the sample

gold_annotation.annotator_view: sentence + gold candidate roles only; no pipeline verdict, no batch-6 reference, no FN/CONTROL label
gold_annotation.primary_label: provides_gold YES / NO / UNCLEAR (UNCLEAR stays UNCLEAR)
gold_annotation.purpose: prevalence of true silences in the new material, not the mechanism behind them

outcome_semantics.true_silence: gold YES but the pipeline produced no candidate pair
outcome_semantics.over_generation: pipeline produced candidates on gold NO sentences
outcome_semantics.silent_on_correct: gold YES and the pipeline found the right pair
outcome_semantics.no_mechanism_analysis: true silences found are counted and reported; they are NOT decomposed in this batch

interpretation_rules_frozen_before_run.replication_found: true silences of the batch-6 type occur in the new corpus -> cross-corpus replication; the recipient mechanism earns its own probe
interpretation_rules_frozen_before_run.not_replicated: no true silences (or a clearly lower rate) in the new corpus -> the finding could not be replicated here; MATERIAL DEPENDENCY becomes a serious explanation class. This is not phrased as 'hypothesis refuted'
interpretation_rules_frozen_before_run.indeterminate: sample too small or prevalence too low to distinguish -> report the observed counts and stop

reporting_requirements: corpus digest and disjointness vs corpora v1-v6 and frozen test material
full run record counts before sampling
silence prevalence with numerator and denominator, per source item
explicit statement that no mechanism analysis was performed
forbidden: no mechanism decomposition of batch-7 silences
